result.summary: The home screen mostly renders correctly, but there is one clear content bug: the Smash Bros Burgers card shows "€NaN delivery" instead of a delivery fee. There are also minor design concerns.

issues.description: The Smash Bros Burgers card in the "Fastest near you" carousel shows "€NaN delivery". This is a data or formatting bug where the delivery fee is not computed or formatted. Users can't tell what delivery costs, and it looks unprofessional.
issues.suggestion: Fix the price calculation or formatting so a valid fee such as "€1.50 delivery" or "Free delivery" is shown. Add a fallback, such as hiding the fee or showing "—", when the value is missing or invalid.

issues.description: The secondary gray text (delivery fees, the "(500+)" rating count, the inactive nav labels, and the search placeholder) is light on a light background and has low contrast. The white time pills over the light Green Bowl Poké image also blend into the background.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text to meet WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1). Add a subtle shadow or border to the time pills.

issues.description: The Green Bowl Poké time pill ("15–25 min") overlaps the plate illustration, and the pale card background has little separation from the white page.
issues.suggestion: Reposition the pill so it doesn't cover the image subject, and add a border or shadow to light cards.
